EASY CARS BIEL — CAR VIDEO CONVERTED FRAMES FOLDER
=====================================================

Drop your converted car video frames here!

Supported file naming formats:
1. frame_0001.webp (or .jpg, .png)
   frame_0002.webp
   ...
2. frame_001.jpg
   frame_002.jpg
   ...
3. ezgif-frame-001.jpg (standard Ezgif naming)
   ezgif-frame-002.jpg
   ...
4. 1.jpg, 2.jpg, 3.jpg ...

How the Scroller works:
- Once you drop your frames in this folder, the website's high-performance HTML5 Canvas Scroller will scrub through your car frames smoothly on scroll.
- Until you add your frames, the site automatically uses your video (/videos/easycars-hero.mp4) to power the scroll-scrubbing effect seamlessly with zero broken images!
